title: patch_file repeatedly fails on .moeb/README.md with valid context
description: patch_file failed 5 times when attempting to insert a new spec index row into .moeb/README.md. Context lines were confirmed correct via read_file_range but the diffy crate reported 'context lines may not match the current file content'. Suspected cause: CR/LF line endings in the file on Windows causing context mismatch in the diffy crate, or a bug in find_closest_context when context lines are very long (200+ characters). A Claude Code Edit tool fallback was required to complete the README update.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file.rs find_closest_context and normalize_hunk_counts behaviour when the file has CRLF line endings on Windows. Add a test case for large-line context matching. Consider normalising line endings to LF on file read in the patch_file tool.

title: Missing moeb tool: Edit (README patch fallback)
description: Used Claude Code Edit tool to insert a row into .moeb/README.md after patch_file failed repeatedly. No moeb equivalent exists for a reliable line-insert that bypasses patch_file when its context-matching fails on large files with long lines.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and fix patch_file context-matching on Windows CRLF files (see companion Critical signal). Alternatively, introduce a write_file_insert_after tool that locates a unique anchor string and appends a line after it, bypassing unified diff parsing entirely.
